facts.claim: Vista (Oceania Cruises): Entered service 2023; 67,800 GT; 1200 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 243 m length; Allura class.
Tata SIA Airlines Limited, doing business as Vistara, was a full-service Indian airline based in Gurgaon, with its hub at Indira Gandhi International Airport.
Vistara ceased operations on 12 November 2024 following its merger with the national flag carrier, Air India.

catalogSpecs.description: Operated by Oceania Cruises; entered service 2023; 70,000 GT; approx. 1,200 guests.
